content.short: Evaa Protocol is the first decentralized lending and borrowing protocol on TON, enabling efficient capital utilization.
content.description: Evaa Protocol is a pioneering decentralized lending and borrowing platform built natively on the TON blockchain. It enables users to supply their digital assets to earn interest or use them as collateral to borrow other tokens in a secure, non-custodial manner. By providing the essential infrastructure for credit markets, Evaa Protocol enhances the capital efficiency of the TON ecosystem, allowing participants to leverage their holdings and manage liquidity according to their financial strategies.
content.meta: Lend and borrow assets securely with Evaa Protocol on TON. Explore DeFi credit markets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
